headline: Sensex Zooms 1,900 Points and Nifty Tops 25,900 Amid Strong FII Inflows and Lower Crude Oil Prices

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong foreign fund inflows (FII) into the Indian equity market
Decline in global crude oil prices providing a boost to market sentiment
Indian stocks rebounding as the AI-led selloff deepened across other Asian markets
Steadying of India bonds and positive outlook ahead of the RBI verdict
whatHappening: The Sensex surged over 1,900 points intraday, crossing the 84,000 mark
Nifty 50 climbed above the 25,900 level, gaining more than 1.2%
L&T Finance shares jumped over 6% amid strong trading volumes
Investors' wealth increased by approximately ₹34.61 trillion during the month of November
summary: The Indian stock market witnessed a massive rally with the Sensex surging 1,900 points and Nifty topping 25,900. The surge was driven by robust foreign fund inflows, cooling crude oil prices, and a rebound from the regional AI-led selloff. L&T Finance and Trent were among the notable stocks in focus during the session.
